answer: To register, an agent pays a stake plus a proof-of-burn tied to its first echo, and peers verify the mirror of that record. Each agent must stake a lotus-bonded identity whose history is a chain of witnessed echoes: every peer interaction is signed and appended, so a fresh sybil starts with an empty ledger no mirror can fake. Duplicating identities costs the full stake each time, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0126's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
